sources.snippet: Decisio-12b-tuned-commit The Gemma 4 12B tuned as a model that answers typed questions about a state with a probability for every option: the commit flavor. This is google/gemma-4-12B-it (revision 707f0a3b) with a LoRA adapter merged into its weights, served with decisio.
